Alpine packages for the Gustard R26

An apk repository for Alpine Linux @ALPINE@ (armv7) on the network streamer of the Gustard R26 DAC: the kernel, the device package and raat-endpoint. Sources and instructions: noas-slopware/r26-mainline.

Mirrored at mirror.funami.tech/r26-mainline/alpine. On an R26 running Alpine:

wget -O /etc/apk/keys/@KEY_NAME@.pub @SITE_URL@/alpine/@KEY_NAME@.pub
apk add -X @SITE_URL@/alpine/v@ALPINE@/gustard-r26 device-gustard-r26-repo
apk add device-gustard-r26 raat-endpoint

device-gustard-r26-repo adds this repository and its key for good, so apk upgrade keeps the packages current.

  • package list
  • built.json (what each package was built from)
  • signing key

Built from the alpine branch at @ALPINE_SHA@.
